title: What Does the Visual Encoder Buy? Visual Information Gain in Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.26917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent scaling studies ask whether vision-language models still need a visual encoder by comparing encoder-free and encoder-based models on the next-token loss of the text in image-text data. This loss can fall without any use of the image, and two runs with the same loss can differ in what they take from it. Visual information gain (VIG) is the loss increase when the image is replaced by a uniform one. It splits exactly into global information, carried by image statistics, and layout information, which shuffling the patches within the image destroys. We apply it to decoders with 158M to 1.04B parameters that read pixel patches through a linear embedding, evaluated every billion tokens up to 40B, and to 19 public checkpoints. In our decoders the image lowers the loss by 3% to 46%, depending on the image type. Global information is present after the first billion tokens. translated_title: 视觉编码器带来了什么？无编码器多模态预训练中的视觉信息增益
translated_abstract: 最近的规模研究通过在图文数据的文本下一词预测损失（next-token loss）上比较无编码器与基于编码器的模型，探讨视觉-语言模型是否仍需要视觉编码器。然而，这种损失可以在完全不使用图像的情况下下降，且两次具有相同损失的运行在从图像中获取的信息上可能存在差异。视觉信息增益（VIG）是指将图像替换为均匀图像时损失的增加量，它可以被精确地分解为全局信息（由图像统计特性携带）和布局信息（通过打乱图像内部的图像块即可破坏的信息）。我们将其应用于参数量从1.58亿到10.4亿的解码器，这些解码器通过线性嵌入读取像素块，每十亿词元评估一次直至400亿词元，同时还评估了19个公开检查点。在我们的解码器中，图像可将损失降低3%至46%，具体取决于图像类型。全局信息在训练的第一个十亿词元之后即已出现，而布局信息起初接近于零，并随训练缓慢增长。
tldr: 提出视觉信息增益（VIG）这一精确度量，将无编码器多模态模型从图像中获取的信息分解为全局信息与布局信息，发现图像可降低3%至46%的预测损失，全局信息在训练早期即出现而布局信息随训练缓慢增长。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Visual Information Gain (VIG), a metric that exactly decomposes what encoder-free multimodal models extract from images into global and layout information, showing images reduce next-token loss by 3% to 46%, with global information emerging early in training while layout information grows slowly.
